source_message.text: For now, I’m happy to use Harbor Quill, although I’m open to other suggestions. The project is meant to encourage people to buy my audio course and help me rebuild my life. After we reach the goal of creating a creator collective DAO, I’d like that DAO to build the platform, which I was thinking of calling ArchiveLedger.

routing_warnings.description: The instruction to use Harbor Quill as the top heading concerns landing-page heading placement and layout rather than changing the approved product name.
